title: Vermiform
summary: VERM'IFORM, adjective [Latin vermis, a worm, and forma, form.] Having the form or shape of a worm; as the vermiform process of the cerebellum.

inlines.v: VERM'IFORM, adjective [Latin vermis, a worm, and forma, form.] Having the form or shape of a worm; as the vermiform process of the cerebellum.
